what: The `.pair11` grid has no column sizing, so its single implicit column grows to the longest code/terminal line and the panel's overflow:hidden cuts every child off at the right edge: inside_bad.js, both terminals, the fold and both captions run 398px past the panel at 390 (96px at 1280). Nothing scrolls, and the right half of the code and the whole TypeError message are invisible.
evidence: Audit 'beyond' at 390: pre.code / pre.term / details.fold-full / p.caption.soft in p42 all r=+398px (1280: +96px); page docOverflow 0, so the checker passes. Crop: scratchpad/review-visual-js-11-15/c11-p42-top.png (code reads `this.crew.forEach(function (member` and the terminal `TypeError: Cannot read properties of u`, no right border). Rule: assets/ext/js-ch11.css:46 `.pair11 { display: grid; gap: 10px; }`. (crops deleted after the review; rerun `bash tools/slot.sh node tools/check_chapter.js <page> --shots DIR` or tools/review/visual-scripts/audit.js (with every <details> opened) to regenerate)
fix: .pair11 { display: grid; gap: 10px } → .pair11 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px } (a grid child's min-width:auto lets one long token widen the column; minmax(0,1fr) pins it to the panel so the code and terminal scroll inside their own boxes)

panel: exercises after p8, p13, p17, p27, p31; spot/parsons lines
what: Chapter overrides make exercise code break inside tokens with no indent: `.ex-body > .code`, `.ex-opt code`, `.parsons li code` and `.spot-line code` all get `overflow-wrap: anywhere` at every width, so lines split as `querySelector` / `All(".prop")`, `event.target.textConte` / `nt`, `addEventListener("clic` / `k"`, and fill exercises lose their one-line shape (`addEventListener(` then the blank alone on the next row), which the engine deliberately prevents on phones.
evidence: Phone sheets: s15m-02.png col 1 (props predict: `querySelector` / `All(".prop").length`), s15m-08.png col 2 (fill: `event.target.textConte` / `nt`, blank on its own row), s15m-00.png col 3 (choice option `addEventListener("clic` / `k"`), s15m-05.png col 2 (spot line 7 `"click` / `"`). Rules: js-ch15.css:42, :101, :103.
fix: `.parsons li code, .spot-line code { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere }` and `.ex-body > .code { … anywhere }` → delete both (the engine wraps parsons/spot lines at spaces and punctuation with a hanging indent and lets fill code scroll); `.ex-opt code { overflow-wrap: anywhere }` → `overflow-wrap: break-word` (break mid-word only when one token is wider than the option)

what: The referee board's test buttons (`.ref14-test`) are a hand-rolled toggle: pressed and focused look the same (both a 3px blue-deep outline), the focus ring is 3px instead of the engine's 4px `--ring`, and there is no `:active` press, `touch-action` or `user-select` rule.
evidence: js-ch14.css:53-58: `.ref14-test[aria-pressed="true"] { box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); outline: 3px solid var(--blue-deep); … }` and `.ref14-test:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue-deep); outline-offset: 3px; }`. Phone sheet s14m-06.png col 2 bottom.
fix: `.ref14-test[aria-pressed="true"] { outline: 3px solid var(--blue-deep) }` → `background: var(--foreground); color: var(--background)` or the engine pressed shadow plus a '← showing' word, drop the custom :focus-visible so the global 4px ring applies, and add `.ref14-test:active { transform: translateY(1px); transition: transform var(--dur-press) var(--ease-out) }` (DESIGN_SYSTEM §4: 'on' is never the same mark as focus; every pressable thing answers the finger). Simpler: build the buttons as `.path-btn` like the file picker above.
